title: feat(types,components,fields,plugin-form,plugin-dashboard)!: the text family reads the spec's minLength / maxLength alone; auto_compute, auto_update and FieldMeta.display_field retire (objectui#11070, round 5)
body:
Refs #11070
Clause-②: yes (narrowing). The snake_case `min_length` / `max_length` retire from the seven text-family field metadata types and from every reader, `auto_compute` / `auto_update` and `FieldMeta.display_field` retire with no reader, and the spec spellings are declared in their place, under the startup no-gradualism rule. It is priced in the changeset. `FormulaFieldMetadata.formula` does NOT move in this PR: the dispatch's stop case applied (see "Stopped at `formula`").

Round 5 of objectui#11070, the text-family round: remainder item 1 of the round-4 review (`5919314708`), under ADR-0049 (enforce-or-remove) and the startup no-gradualism rule. Claim `5919912087`.

## What changed

- **Types (`@object-ui/types`).** `TextFieldMetadata` and `TextareaFieldMetadata` declare `minLength` / `maxLength`; `MarkdownFieldMetadata`, `HtmlFieldMetadata`, `RichtextFieldMetadata`, `EmailFieldMetadata` and `UrlFieldMetadata` declare `maxLength`. Each is `SpecField['minLength']` / `SpecField['maxLength']`, by reference, the way round 3 did `PasswordFieldMetadata`, and each replaces the snake_case member the type declared. `FormulaFieldMetadata.auto_compute` and `SummaryFieldMetadata.auto_update` are removed, with a comment saying why. The `form.ts` field-widget comment now says no widget reads a snake_case second spelling any more. `LabelSchema` is untouched.
- **Readers read the spec spelling alone.** The form renderer's built-in `input`, `textarea` and fallback branches (their local `max_length` destructure-and-drop went with the read), `buildValidationRules`, `TextAreaField`, `RichTextField`, `EmbeddableForm`'s `applyDefaultMaxLengths` and `ObjectForm`'s length forwarding. `TextField`'s read is now typed through the declared members. Every comment around these reads was rewritten to be true.
- **`display_field` dead copy (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`).** `CELL_RELATIONAL_META_KEYS` and `FieldMeta` drop `display_field`: `LookupCellRenderer` reads `displayField` / `reference_field` since objectui#7155, and the ingestion pass folds a served `display_field` onto `displayField` (objectui#7650's ruling A). Once it left `keyof FieldMeta`, the derived band could no longer refuse it on an authored column, so `ObjectDataTable` carries a hand-written `ObjectDataTableRetiredDisplayFieldSnakeTombstone` on both `EnrichedColumn` and `AuthoredColumnOverrides`, the way round 4 handled `reference_to`. Two pins prove the tombstone, not the band, does the refusing.
- **Q2's fixture correction.** The three `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/fields-formula/*.json` fixtures drop `expression`. Measured: `FormField` declares neither `formula` nor `expression`, and nothing on the hand-authored form path reads either (`FormulaField` reads `returnType` alone and formats a value the backend computed). So under ADR-0049 the fixtures carry neither spelling.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/fields/{text,textarea,email,url,rich-text,widget-props}.mdx` follow in their typed fences, plaintext fences and prose; `formula.mdx` and `summary.mdx` lose the two retired switches.
- **Tests.** The length pins now assert the spec spelling caps and the retired spelling caps nothing; `strict-face-read-keys-11070.test.ts` moves `min_length` / `max_length` to its RETIRED list and adds type-level pins (every text-family type carries the spec members by reference; none carries a retired member).
- **Changesets.** `.changeset/11070-text-family-round5.md` (minor for `types`, `components`, `fields`, `plugin-form`; patch for `plugin-dashboard`), with the break measured before and after under a BREAKING heading. Dated, append-only notes: `.changeset/11070-reference-to-round4.md` carries the reviewer's notes (a) and (b) from `5919834721`; `6140-field-metadata-rows-option-description`, `6694-dashboard-lookup-reference-meta`, `7083-richtext-field-metadata` and `8438-richtext-maxlength-visible` get a note each, because this round makes a sentence in each false.

## Stopped at `formula` (the dispatch's stop case)

`FormulaFieldMetadata.formula` to `expression` was measured and NOT done. The Studio read `def.expression ?? def.formula` (in `ObjectFieldInspector`, with `ObjectFormCanvas`'s stub fallback beside it) seeds the CEL editor from a STORED legacy value, and the read door deliberately does not strip `formula`: objectui#6526 was ruled option B (director batch, maintainer 「12683 本轮不处理，其他同意」, 2026-08-27), and `packages/types/src/internal/retired-field-keys.ts` records that column as a ruling ("Flipping this `false` is overturning a maintainer ruling"). The ingestion fold does not fold `formula` either: measured at this head, `normalizeFieldReferenceKeys` leaves a `formula`-only def as it is and warns that it cannot canonicalize the key, and objectui#6043 refused a blind rename to `expression`. That is the brief's stop case, so this PR touches no `formula` reader, declaration or doc; the question and its four-axis options go to the seat in the os-dev-report on objectui#11070.

## Census, before and after

Base `5f2d967` (`origin/main`, the merge base), head `25aa7bf`.

**Code-line reads and declarations**, production source (`packages/*/src`, `apps/*/src`), tests and comment lines excluded:

| key | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| `max_length` / `min_length` reads | 13: form renderer 3 reads + 3 local strips; `buildValidationRules` 2; `RichTextField` 1; `TextAreaField` 1; `EmbeddableForm` 1; `ObjectForm` 2 | 0 |
| `max_length` / `min_length` declarations | 9 members on 7 types | 0 (spec members by reference: `minLength` on 2 types, `maxLength` on 7) |
| `auto_compute` / `auto_update` | 1 declaration each, 0 reads | 0 |
| `FieldMeta.display_field` | 1 declaration + 1 copy-set entry, 0 reads | 0, plus the tombstone type |

**Writes** (key-value spellings):

| where | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| test files, `max_length` / `min_length` | 27 in 11 files | 14 in 9 files, every one a negative pin or a historical docblock table |
| `content/docs`, `max_length` / `min_length` | 10 | 0 |
| `fields-formula` fixtures, `expression` | 3 | 0 |
| `auto_compute` / `auto_update`, whole tree outside changesets | 2 | 0 |

**Type-checker census** (LanguageService `findReferences` from every declaration, 5594 files, at `f61dab1` and at the round's commit `32d80bd`; the round's code is byte-identical since, and the head type-check below would fail on any typed read of a removed member): at base, `max_length` had 7 declarations and 2 typed production reads (`RichTextField`, `TextAreaField`), `min_length` 2 declarations, and `auto_compute`, `auto_update`, `FieldMeta.display_field` and `FormulaFieldMetadata.formula` one declaration each and zero typed reads. At head none of the retired members exists; `maxLength` has 8 declarations and 3 typed production reads. The form renderer, `buildValidationRules`, `EmbeddableForm` and `ObjectForm` read through `any`, which the type checker cannot see, so the grep table above is the reading for them.

**Other `display_field` readers** stay: `resolveActionParams`, `ObjectChart` and `deriveMasterDetail` read it off an object-schema definition, not off a `FieldMeta`, so they are outside this item (see Acceptance notes).

H4 is false as posed: class (ii) moves by zero, because none of the length pair, `formula` or the two switches occurs in M3's JSON corpus at this base. The three refusals that leave are the `expression` fixtures (the class the round-3 report called class (i)).

## Runtime probe (a scratch vitest file, never committed)

Base `5f2d967` against head `25aa7bf`; both readings are identical to the first ones taken at `f61dab1` / `32d80bd`.

`SchemaRenderer` / `ObjectForm` / `buildValidationRules` / `applyDefaultMaxLengths`, same inputs at base and head, each spelled both ways:

| case | `maxLength` base, head | `max_length` base | `max_length` head |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) hand-authored `form`, built-in `input` 5 / `textarea` 7 | `maxlength` 5 / 7, both | 5 / 7 | none; the element carries an inert `max_length` attribute |
| (b) `ObjectForm`, a `DataSource` other than `ObjectStackAdapter`, `textarea` 111 | `maxlength` 111 and `0/111`, both | 111 and `0/111` | neither |
| (c) the same through `ObjectStackAdapter.getObjectSchema` | 111 and `0/111`, both | 111 and `0/111` | 111 and `0/111` (the ingestion fold) |
| (d) `buildValidationRules`, 9 / 2 | `maxLength` + `minLength` rules, both | both rules | no rules |
| (e) `applyDefaultMaxLengths`, custom `textarea` 40 | 40, both | no `maxLength` (opted out) | the 5000 default |

These are the rows the changeset's BREAKING section states.

## Hypotheses

- **H1 holds.** Every in-repo read of the snake pair was in the brief's list; the grep census found no other, and the type checker found only the two typed ones inside it. Before 13 reads, after 0.
- **H2 holds** (objectstack `origin/main` `f6ccca4a4`). `FieldSchema` at the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 refuses `min_length`, `max_length`, `formula`, `auto_compute`, `auto_update` and `display_field` by name with `unrecognized_keys` (control `zzz_not_real` refused, `minLength` / `maxLength` / `expression` / `displayField` accepted). The example apps write `maxLength` and `expression` and neither snake length key nor `formula`; objectstack's `os doctor` flags `max_length` / `min_length` as snake_case config keys. The other package hits are validation error-code names and settings labels, not field keys.
- **H3 holds.** `auto_compute`, `auto_update` and `FieldMeta.display_field` had zero readers, typed or untyped.
- **H4 is false as posed** (above).

## Checks

  - `packages/app-shell/`: exit 1, 959 files passed, 1 failed, 1 skipped; 9565 tests passed, 1 failed, 9 skipped. The one red is `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished.test.tsx`'s "that way back follows the DECLARED landing" case, tripped by the network-escape guard (a read reached `localhost:3000/api/v1/meta` after the test body). It is load-dependent and unrelated to this diff: no `app-shell` file is in it, the file passes 3 of 3 runs alone at this head and 3 of 3 at the base `5f2d967`, and the whole `app-shell` suite passed (955 files) at the previous head `9e03521`, before the last merge of `main` (which changed nothing under `app-shell/src/console`).
  - `apps/console/`: exit 0, 139 files passed; 1593 tests passed.

Bump: minor for the four packages whose published types or readers narrow (the fixed group never declares `major`; the break is stated), patch for `plugin-dashboard`, whose change is invisible on screen.
- Lint, the 25 changed TS files against the merge base, each package's own form (`eslint`, inline config honoured): 0 errors, warnings at or below base in every file (base blobs linted through `--stdin`). With `--no-inline-config` two errors appear, in `RichTextField` and `ObjectDataTable`, both present at base on untouched lines. Type-aware linting is off (`tseslint.configs.recommended`, no parser project), so the diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 42 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

**Ablations**, each on the committed head, prediction written first, mutation through objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit once, blob moved, restore blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- A2, `text.mdx`'s typed fence writes `max_length: 120`: `check:doc-snippets` exit 1, 1 of 698 failed, TS2561 naming `max_length` against `TextFieldMetadata` (the rebuilt dist declares 0 `max_length`, the base source 7), as predicted.

(The first attempt was refused by the tool before anything ran: its replacement contained its anchor. It is not counted.)

42 files, +559 / −456 (1015 changed lines): 6 changesets (1 new, 5 dated notes), 3 fixture files, 8 docs pages, 11 source files and 14 test files. That is within the brief's "about 40", the families are coherent, and nothing was cut.

## Acceptance notes

- **Other `display_field` legs.** `resolveActionParams` (`field.displayField ?? field.display_field ?? field.reference_field`), `ObjectChart` (`|| fieldDef.display_field`) and `deriveMasterDetail` (twice) read the snake spelling off an object-schema definition. objectui#7650's ruling A made consumer narrowing in this family safe once the ingestion fold covers it, and it does. They are not `FieldMeta` reads, so this round did not touch them. Noted, not filed.
- `.changeset/7166-retire-inert-fieldmeta-copies.md` lists `display_field` among the keys `LookupCellRenderer` reads. That was already untrue before this round (objectui#7155 retired the leg) and this diff does not touch `plugin-grid`'s copy set, so no note was appended.
- objectstack's `packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-contract.ts` (the shared FLS contract case table) writes `formula` on its formula field. It is a test contract, not a producer that reaches objectui; noted only, since `formula` is stopped here.
